channel.title: Albert Arnó — Writing
channel.description: Albert Arnó is a physician and the founder of onmedic, a Barcelona health-technology studio working in eHealth since 2000. Notes on building measurement software for the body.

item.title: What I learned deleting 93% of my own website
item.description: AnalyticsZone had 15,004 URLs across eleven hostnames and almost no readers. Cutting it to about 1,100 pages on one host was the most useful thing I did all year.

item.title: Restarting this blog, seven years later
item.description: This site published 194 posts between 2012 and 2019, and I wrote none of them. Here is what it actually was, why it stopped, and what it is now.

item.title: The maths runs on your phone, and that costs me things
item.description: Computing sports metrics on the device instead of the server is easy to say in a privacy policy and harder to live with. What it actually forecloses.
